answer_1.quote: We sample English texts ... and translate the English texts into Chinese using two different LLMs ... produce translations. We also synthesize French and German translations ...

answer_2.quote: We report accuracy as our metric for the binary classification task... We also report auroc... We further explore the correlation between T-index and existing automatic QE metrics, including 3 reference-based metrics, xCOMET, BLEURT-20, and BLEU, and one reference‑free metric, COMET‑Kiwi22.

answer_3.quote: We also include LLM-as-a-judge method for comparison: LLama3.3-Instruct-70B and Qwen2.5-Instruct-72B (see prompts in Appendix D).

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation for two purposes... Pointwise annotation provides direct continuous ratings of the translationese degree (6‑point Likert scale 0‑5)... Pairwise annotation ... annotators are presented with a pair of translations ... forced (without a tie) to choose the one that exhibits more translationese.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate translationese on a 0‑5 Likert scale (pointwise) or select the translation showing more translationese in a pair (pairwise).
criteria: choice of higher translationese in pairwise comparison
